comment: K1039 supported placing the rectifier candidates above the smooth candidates under shared low-rate plain SGD. K1006 supported C’s three-LN advantage, while K1016 discouraged ranking by width alone. The remaining ordering was architectural judgment: D’s residual path and terminal LN favored it over E; A’s residual path plausibly enabled faster mean fitting than B’s plain SiLU stack with an unnormalized tail, despite B’s extra LN. Those explanations are consistent with the gold order but are not isolated causal evidence. No new general rule was tested.
